summary: Frontend-only iteration 4 verification for Rekap Cadangan KAI — native date pickers + white KAI logo. All acceptance criteria met on 390x844 mobile web viewport. (1) On /rekap the two date fields (data-testid='rekap-start-input' and 'rekap-end-input') render as raw HTML <input type='date'> with the data-testid attribute correctly forwarded — playwright fill() with ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' works; the browser shows 'mm/dd/yyyy' + calendar icon (screenshot verified). (2) After TERAPKAN with start=2024-01-01 & end=2026-12-31, the 'Rentang Data : 2024-01-01 s/d 2026-12-31' line echoes exactly; after RESET the fields clear and 'Rentang Data : Semua tanggal' is shown. (3) The new white-K/I logo (kai-logo-white.png, 37.5KB) is bundled and visible against the blue gradient on both login (testID kai-logo, 96x40) and dashboard (testID kai-logo, 72x30); no HTTP 404s in console. (4) Regression: admin login OK, dashboard shows 9 category cards + sticky REKAP TEXT CTA, UNDUH .TXT downloads 'rekap-cadangan-2026-08-30T22-48-54.txt' via browser Blob path, Pusdal1 has NO rekap button and hitting /rekap directly yields the 403 error message 'Hanya administrator yang dapat mengakses rekap'. No React Native red-screen or console errors (only the intentional 403 for Pusdal1). No deprecated Expo packages introduced (still uses @react-native-community/datetimepicker, expo-linear-gradient, expo-file-system/legacy).
critical_code_review_comments: rekap.tsx DateField uses require('react') inside the component to call React.createElement on web — works, but the ESLint disable comment implies a lint quirk; consider a top-level `import React from 'react'` + `React.createElement('input', ...)` for cleaner code. Not a bug.

openPicker() early-returns for iOS/Android but does not guard against Platform.OS === 'web' calling it — currently unreachable because DateField on web never triggers onPressNative, but a defensive `if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;` at top would be safer if the component is reused.
iOS modal spinner path (setIosPicker) not tested in web preview — needs a native iOS build to verify; code path visually matches the spec (modal sheet + Pilih tanggal DARI/SAMPAI + SELESAI button).
isValidDate('YYYY-MM-DD') check in applyFilter() is now practically redundant on web (browser <input type='date'> always emits ISO) but still useful for native paths — keep it.

The new kai-logo-white.png (37.5KB) coexists with the old kai-logo.png (41.7KB). Only the white variant is now referenced by all screens; the old asset appears unused after this iteration — main agent may remove it if not used elsewhere.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all iteration 4 acceptance criteria pass; iteration 3 regressions all pass

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing TEST_* entries from prior iterations were used passively to verify the filter shows/hides content when a range is applied.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified: date fields on /rekap now render as native <input type='date'> on web (data-testid attributes preserved: rekap-start-input, rekap-end-input) — playwright can use page.fill(selector, 'YYYY-MM-DD') directly. On Android openPicker() uses DateTimePickerAndroid.open (imperative), on iOS a bottom-sheet modal <DateTimePicker mode='date' display='spinner'/> is rendered with testID rekap-ios-picker-done for the SELESAI button. kai-logo testID (previously mapped to kai-logo.png) now points at kai-logo-white.png — white monogram on blue gradient. All other testIDs from iteration 3 remain stable.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. Native date picker rendered inline with a runtime `require('react')` (RNW pattern) — valid but slightly unusual; noted in code review.
